name: staffmor
description: Planning, specs, experiments, visual review and lifecycle email methods from Staffmor, the AI team office.

interface.longDescription: Five working methods Staffmor gives its AI teams: map the unknowns before a decision, turn a big feature into small verifiable units, run a bounded experiment with a fixed baseline, compare a build against its visual reference, and plan email sequences that convert. Each skill keeps the original author's credit and MIT license.
defaultPrompt: Map what we know and don't know before we pick an approach
Split this feature into small units we can each verify
Plan a welcome email sequence for new signups
